description: Creates and initializes the AmendmentTable, loading supported, enabled, and vetoed amendments from configuration and database, ensuring database votes take precedence over config.
Constructor that sets up the internal state, loads votes from the database, parses config, and initializes the amendment map with support/vote status for each amendment.
Persists a vote (up, down, obsolete) for an amendment to the database, ensuring the latest vote is stored.
Inserts or updates a row in the FeatureVotes table in the database to record a node's vote for a specific amendment.
Reads the latest votes for all amendments from the FeatureVotes table in the database and applies them to the AmendmentTable.
Determines which amendments this node will announce support for in its validations, based on supported, enabled, and upvoted amendments.
Returns the list of amendments this node desires to see enabled, as determined by doValidation.
Tallies validator votes for amendments, determines which amendments have gained or lost majority, and returns actions (e.g., introduce pseudo-transactions) for the next ledger.
Constructs a set of amendments with their vote counts and computes the majority threshold based on current rules and trusted validations.
Checks if a given amendment has enough votes to pass the majority threshold.
Updates the internal state of the AmendmentTable after a ledger is validated, enabling amendments and updating majority status as needed.
Applies an amendment pseudo-transaction to the ledger, updating the enabled amendments list and majority status, and triggers activation logic if the amendment is enabled.
